q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a steel barrel?
title: Steel drum carbon footprint per drum
short: Multiply the steel sheet per drum by the steel supplier's figure, then add shearing, seam welding, painting and curing energy. Divide the plant's energy by drums passed, stated by capacity.

ul: Cold rolled steel sheet for body and heads.

p: Report per drum by capacity, often 210 litres, and sheet thickness.

example.title: Worked example: steel drum unit per drum (one month)
lines: Plant total: 48,900 / 40,000 = 1.222 kg CO2 per drum
Add steel for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
